name: Amoxicillin + clavulanic acid
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Both components are excreted in urine (amoxicillin 50% to 70%, clavulanate 25% to 40% unchanged in 6 hours). The US label needs no dose change unless kidney impairment is severe: below a GFR of 30 mL/min do not use the 875 mg tablet, give 250 or 500 mg every 12 hours (GFR 10–30) or every 24 hours (below 10), and give extra doses during and after hemodialysis. These are oral doses; IV co-amoxiclav is not covered by the US label.
kidney_function_basis: Label states GFR in mL/min (not indexed); cut-offs 30 and 10. Shown in the CrCl band rows.

bands.recommendation: Oral: no dose change; the label reduces dose only below GFR 30 (label).

Oral: GFR 10–30: 500 mg or 250 mg (amoxicillin component) every 12 hours by severity; do not use the 875 mg tablet (label). IV co-amoxiclav (for example 1.2 g vials): not covered by the US label, and no EU/UK SmPC is in the database yet; no IV kidney dose is given here. Specialist input.

Oral: GFR 10–14: 500 mg or 250 mg (amoxicillin component) every 12 hours. GFR below 10: 500 mg or 250 mg (amoxicillin component) every 24 hours by severity. No 875 mg tablet (label). IV co-amoxiclav (for example 1.2 g vials): not covered by the US label, and no EU/UK SmPC is in the database yet; no IV kidney dose is given here. Specialist input.

hd.text: Oral: 500 mg or 250 mg (amoxicillin component) every 24 hours by severity, plus an additional dose both during and at the end of dialysis (label). IV co-amoxiclav (for example 1.2 g vials): not covered by the US label, and no EU/UK SmPC is in the database yet; no IV kidney dose is given here. Specialist input.

pd.text: Oral and IV: no peritoneal dialysis dosing in label. Specialist input.

crrt.text: Not in label; the cited CRRT review (Li 2020) gives no regimen for this drug. Specialist input.
crrt.short: No CRRT data in cited sources

dialyzable: Yes: may be removed by hemodialysis (label). Low protein binding (amoxicillin about 18%, clavulanate about 25%).
monitoring: Kidney function for dose; liver tests in hepatic impairment; rash; diarrhea (CDAD); INR with oral anticoagulants (label). Keep fluid intake up at high doses (crystalluria with overdose).

pediatric.usual_dose: Under 12 weeks: 30 mg/kg/day divided every 12 hours, using the 125 mg/5 mL suspension (label). 3 months and older, under 40 kg: 25 to 45 mg/kg/day divided every 12 hours, or 20 to 40 mg/kg/day divided every 8 hours (amoxicillin component); 40 kg or more: adult dose (label).

renal.recommendation: No pediatric kidney dosing in label (the GFR table is not age-specific). Specialist input.

No EU/UK SmPC for IV co-amoxiclav is in data/drugs/labels-eu yet. PH slug co-amoxiclav (6 products) is aliased to this page.
